inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: Based on evidence obtained alleged abuse was not reported immediately by a staff member.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.1201(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left unsupervised on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: There are 2 large play structures that have less then the required 6 inches of loose fill with in the 6 feet use zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: There were several play structures that need 6 feet use zone around them .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: It was found during the inspection that a classroom with a group of 18, 5-6 year old children that were resting on their mats did not have adequate lighting to supervise the children as required. This was corrected immediately during the inspection.
Children's Records - Admission Information: It was found during the investigation that a child's admission information was not on file as required.
Screen Time Activities - May Supplement Activities Not Replace: It was found during the investigation that screen time has been used on several occasions to replace activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - May Supplement Activities Not Replace (26 TAC §746.2207(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Medication Records: It was found during the investigation that several medication records were not maintained as required.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: It was found that a caregiver failed to intervene before a child under their care received an injury requiring medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment - No Overlap: It was found during the inspection that the use zone for a piece of rotating equipment is overlaping other use zones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4813(c))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: It was found that a caregiver used her hand to push a child's head back to force the child to rest.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: It was found during the investigation that an infant was asleep in a restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: It was found during the inspection the operation did not have a fire drill for the month of September.    This was corrected during the inspection as the operation conducted a fire drill during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was found that caregivers did not supervise children in their care as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: It was found during the investigation that a caregiver used prohibited punishment.
Placement of Groups - Not Exceed Room Capacity: Several of the classrooms have routinely exceeded the room capacity for amount of children allowed based on square footage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Placement of Groups - Not Exceed Room Capacity (26 TAC §746.1505(3))
